{"lean_source":"import Std

namespace VeriSlop

inductive VertexResult where
  | unreachable
  | negativeInfinity
  | finite (distance : Nat)
  deriving DecidableEq

def valid (n source : Nat) : Prop := 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 10 ∧ source < n

def solve (n source : Nat) : Array VertexResult :=
  Array.replicate n VertexResult.unreachable

def reference (n source : Nat) : Array VertexResult :=
  Array.replicate n VertexResult.unreachable

theorem result_matches_reference (n source : Nat) (h : valid n source) :
    solve n source = reference n source := by sorry

theorem preserves_structure (n source : Nat) (h : valid n source) :
    (solve n source).size = n := by sorry

theorem deterministic (n source : Nat) (h : valid n source) :
    solve n source = solve n source := by sorry

theorem standard_library_only (n source : Nat) (h : valid n source) :
    solve n source = reference n source := by sorry

theorem non_vacuity :
    (∃ n source : Nat, valid n source ∧ solve n source = reference n source) ∧
    (∃ n source : Nat, valid n source) := by sorry

end VeriSlop","formalization":{"schema_version":"0.1","artifact_kind":"formalization_candidate","profile_id":"graph_shortest_paths.v0_1","lean_toolchain":"leanprover/lean4:v4.34.1","lean_file":"Contract.lean","bindings":[{"obligation":"D1","declarations":["VeriSlop.VertexResult","VeriSlop.solve"]},{"obligation":"A1","predicate":"VeriSlop.valid"},{"obligation":"O1","theorem":"VeriSlop.result_matches_reference"},{"obligation":"O2","theorem":"VeriSlop.preserves_structure"},{"obligation":"O3","theorem":"VeriSlop.deterministic"},{"obligation":"O4","theorem":"VeriSlop.standard_library_only"}],"internal_obligations":[{"id":"W1","kind":"non_vacuity","theorem":"VeriSlop.non_vacuity","witnesses_for":["A1"],"description":"valid success and error cases exist"}]}}
